name: FutureBuilder
desc: You can specify a Future object, which can monitor the status of asynchronous execution and build different interfaces in the constructor based on the status. Note that the Future object cannot be created simultaneously with the FutureBuilder, otherwise it may cause excessive refreshing.

fields.name: future
fields.desc: The asynchronous computation to which this builder is currently connected, possibly null.

fields.name: builder
fields.desc: The build strategy currently used by this builder.

fields.name: initialData
fields.desc: The data that will be used to create the snapshots provided until a non-null [future] has completed.
